title: NC-PLUS-LOOPBREAK-GH-1: Classify dispatch failure cause (doer-skill gap, scope too big, missing capability) when LOOPBREAK fires
body:
**Owner:** portfolio-manager
**Trigger:** the backlog item PLUS-LOOPBREAK-GH-1 was parked needs-code by the in-tick doer
**Done check:** cmd:python3 scripts/needs_code_bridge.py --probe PLUS-LOOPBREAK-GH-1
**Status:** open

Classify dispatch failure cause (doer-skill gap, scope too big, missing capability) when LOOPBREAK fires

Backlog done check: Every item with >=3 failed dispatches has exactly one failure cause recorded and a concrete unblock action chosen (reassign doer, split item, or new capability item); probe confirms no LOOPBREAK item lacks a cause+action pair.

Triage: requires updating database schema to store failure causes and unblock actions | first step: design database schema changes to accommodate failure cause and unblock action storage

Bridged from the backlog by scripts/needs_code_bridge.py (NEEDS-CODE-BRIDGE-1). The change is code, data or a test that a loop consumes; a document alone does not close it.
